svg.text: Error Handling Architecture — LLD
Error Taxonomy & Classification
Network errors: offline, timeout, DNS failure — retry eligible
Server errors: 5xx — retry with backoff; 429 → Retry-After header
Client errors: 400 Bad Request → show validation; 401 → refresh token
403 Forbidden → permission denied UI; 404 → empty state, not error
Render errors: thrown in React tree → caught by Error Boundary
Logic errors (bugs): TypeError, ReferenceError — never expose stack to user
Business errors: domain violations returned in response body, not HTTP status
Error codes: machine-readable code + human message in API response body
React Error Boundaries
Class component with componentDidCatch + getDerivedStateFromError
Granularity: wrap independent sections (sidebar, feed, chart) separately
Fallback UI: skeleton/placeholder + "Something went wrong" + retry button
Report to Sentry: logError(error, info) in componentDidCatch
Reset key: pass resetKey prop; when it changes, boundary clears error state
Async errors: NOT caught by boundaries — use try/catch in async handlers
Global unhandled: window.onerror + unhandledrejection → report + ignore in UI
react-error-boundary: useErrorBoundary hook for functional component integration
API Error Handling & Retry Strategy
Centralized interceptor: Axios interceptor / fetch wrapper handles auth errors
401 handler: queue requests → refresh token → replay — only one refresh in flight
Retry on: 429 (with Retry-After), 503 (service unavailable), network errors
Never retry: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 — retrying won't help
Idempotency: POST mutations need idempotency key to allow safe retry
Retry budget: max 3 retries; exponential backoff with jitter; total timeout cap
React Query: built-in retry, staleTime, gcTime, error state per query
Toast vs inline: transient errors → toast; blocking errors → inline message
Monitoring, Observability & UX
Sentry: dsn config, beforeSend for PII scrubbing, release tracking
Source maps: upload to Sentry at deploy; never serve publicly
Breadcrumbs: Sentry auto-captures XHR, console, navigation before error
Error grouping: Sentry fingerprints similar errors; tune to reduce noise
Error rate alerts: alert on error rate spike vs baseline (% not absolute count)
User impact: Sentry session replay links error to exact user interaction sequence
Error message UX: "Something went wrong" + error ID users can cite to support
Recovery actions: retry button, refresh page, go home — always give an escape
Classify error first: retry vs show vs silently ignore
Granular Error Boundaries: wrap independent sections
Retry: 429/503/network — never 400/401/403/404
Sentry: PII scrub + source maps + session replay
Always give the user an escape: retry / home / refresh
